title: Academy AF A ContentAggregator
description:
**Job Summary**
Serve as a senior content aggregation specialist within the Academy AF A function designing and operating robust hybrid solutions that unify learning data and digital assets from diverse enterprise and external sources. Apply expertise in Net SQL Python and modern generative AI platforms including Gemini AI Claude and Open AI to curate classify and expose high quality training content. Deliver reliable day shift outcomes that elevate organizational capability and societal impact through ac
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design and maintain scalable content aggregation workflows that collect normalize and classify learning materials from internal repositories and approved external sources to ensure a unified and reliable Academy catalog.
* Develop and optimize Net based services and APIs that securely expose aggregated content to front end applications and downstream platforms while maintaining high performance and reliability.
* Create robust Python scripts and automation routines to process metadata perform text transformation and orchestrate batch ingestion jobs that keep the content library current and comprehensive.
* Use SQL to design efficient data models queries and procedures that support fast retrieval advanced filtering and detailed reporting across the consolidated learning content store.
* Apply Gemini AI to generate insightful summaries recommend relevant learning paths and enrich metadata so that employees can quickly discover material that supports their growth and productivity.
* Apply Claude capabilities to analyze long form learning content extract key concepts and improve instructional clarity enhancing the overall quality and accessibility of Academy assets.
* Apply Open AI models to enable personalized content suggestions conversational search and adaptive learning experiences that improve engagement and skill acquisition for diverse learners.
* Collaborate closely with instructional designers and subject matter experts to validate aggregated content refine taxonomies and ensure alignment with enterprise learning objectives and compliance standards.
* Implement robust data quality checks observability metrics and issue resolution routines that minimize broken links duplicate records and outdated material across hybrid content pipelines.
* Document aggregation processes data flows and integration patterns in clear operational guides that enable consistent day shift support and smooth handoffs among distributed team members.
* Coordinate with platform engineers and security specialists to ensure that all integrations data movements and AI workloads comply with governance requirements and protect sensitive information.
* Monitor usage analytics feedback signals and content performance indicators to propose targeted improvements that enhance learning outcomes and amplify the impact of Academy programs on society.
* Drive continuous refinement of hybrid work practices using collaboration tools and structured communication methods so that onsite and remote team members deliver cohesive and predictable content services.

**Qualifications**

* Bring seven to eleven years of experience working with enterprise grade content or data platforms demonstrating accountability for end to end aggregation curation and delivery outcomes in complex environments.
* Show advanced proficiency in Net application development with emphasis on building secure and modular services that integrate seamlessly with databases APIs and generative AI platforms.
* Demonstrate strong SQL skills in designing normalized schemas writing optimized queries and tuning data workloads to support analytics reporting and rapid content discovery.
* Exhibit deep Python expertise in building automation frameworks data processing utilities and integration scripts that manage large volumes of structured and unstructured learning materials.
* Provide hands on experience working with Gemini AI Claude and Open AI to design practical solutions for summarization classification recommendation and conversational access to learning content.
* Offer a track record of operating effectively in hybrid work models by using digital collaboration tools documenting workflows and maintaining consistent communication during standard day shifts.
* Prefer prior exposure to corporate learning ecosystems or digital education platforms where content aggregation curation standards and learner centric experiences were central responsibilities.

**Certifications Required**
Preferred certifications include Microsoft Certified Net Developer and Microsoft Certified Azure Data Engineer or equivalent cloud data qualification relevant to SQL and Python.

* Manage scope, schedule, budget, capacity, quality, risks, issues, assumptions, and change control; intervene early when delivery deviates from commitments.

* Lead platform migrations, modernisation initiatives, releases, cutovers, hypercare, and transition to operations with clear readiness and acceptance criteria.

* Define enterprise data strategy, target-state architecture, reference architectures, transition states, and prioritised transformation roadmaps aligned to business and AI objectives.
* Architect modern cloud-native data platforms, including data lakes, lakehouses, warehouses, streaming solutions, data products, semantic layers, APIs, and analytical consumption patterns.
* Lead conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling using dimensional, relational, Data Vault, graph, ontology, and domain-oriented approaches as appropriate.

* Embed data quality controls, reconciliation, auditability, privacy-by-design, role-based access, encryption, and regulatory compliance into solution architecture and delivery.
* Partner with cyber security, risk, legal, compliance, and operations teams to ensure controls are demonstrable and audit-ready.
* Build trusted relationships with C-suite sponsors, business leaders, product owners, technology executives, and delivery partners.
* Translate complex business needs into clear solution options, investment cases, roadmaps, and outcome-based delivery plans.
* Facilitate executive workshops, architecture forums, steering committees, and difficult decision-making conversations.
* Own or support proposals, solution shaping, estimates, statements of work, delivery models, contract assumptions, and commercial negotiations.
* Manage programme financials, forecasting, burn, margin, resourcing, vendors, and third-party commitments.
* Identify opportunities for account growth, reusable assets, accelerators, and follow-on transformation initiatives.
* Lead multidisciplinary teams of architects, data engineers, platform engineers, analysts, data scientists, DevOps specialists, quality engineers, and project managers.
* Set clear accountabilities, create a high-performance culture, mentor senior practitioners, and develop succession and capability plans.
* Promote engineering excellence, knowledge sharing, reusable patterns, continuous improvement, and responsible use of data and AI.
* Contribute to hiring, workforce planning, communities of practice, thought leadership, and organisational capability development.

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* Typically 15+ years of technology experience, including substantial experience delivering enterprise data programmes and operating in a lead data or solution architecture capacity.
* Demonstrable ownership of large, complex, multi-team programmes with responsibility for delivery governance, senior stakeholders, budgets, quality, and commercial outcomes.
* Strong experience designing and delivering cloud data platforms on Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud; deep expertise in at least one ecosystem is essential.
* Proven experience with modern data platforms and technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Synapse Analytics, Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Kafka, cloud object storage, and modern BI tools.
* Advanced knowledge of SQL and strong working understanding of Python or PySpark, data integration, distributed processing, DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and observability.
* Solid command of data modelling, metadata management, data quality, master data management, governance, privacy, security, and lifecycle management.
* Experience architecting AI-ready data foundations and integrating machine learning, generative AI, vector, semantic, ontology, or knowledge graph capabilities is desirable.
* Excellent executive communication, consulting, negotiation, facilitation, decision-making, and conflict-resolution skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Cloud architecture or data engineering certification in Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or Snowflake certification.
* TOGAF, DAMA/CDMP, or an equivalent data or enterprise architecture credential.
* PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, Scrum, or an equivalent programme or Agile delivery certification.
* ITIL certification is advantageous for roles with service transition or operational accountability.
* Delivery against agreed outcomes, milestones, budget, quality standards, and contractual commitments.
* Architecture compliance, reduction in technical debt, and adoption of reusable standards and patterns.
* Platform reliability, performance, security, data quality, observability, and unit-cost improvement.
* Stakeholder confidence, client satisfaction, benefits realisation, and successful adoption of delivered capabilities.
* Team engagement, capability growth, predictable staffing, and development of future technical and delivery leaders.

**About the Role:**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is seeking a Senior AI Engineering Architect to serve as a technology leader driving enterprise-scale AI strategy, architecture decisions, and innovation across global client engagements. This role is central to shaping how AI engineering capabilities are built, scaled, and adopted across application security and offensive security domains.
  
  
As a senior technologist, you will lead front-end client conversations, define enterprise-level AI architecture standards, and guide organizations in solving complex real-world problems using advanced AI capabilities. While primarily focused on architecture and technology leadership, you will remain hands-on when required to prototype solutions, validate emerging approaches, and solve complex technical challenges.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Define and evolve enterprise-level AI reference architectures, frameworks, and engineering standards.
* Approve and guide key architecture decisions across multiple programs and client engagements.
* Lead executive-level client discussions, architecture workshops, and strategic solutioning initiatives.
* Shape and drive AI engineering capability development across application security and VAPT domains.
* Champion adoption of emerging AI technologies, including advanced LLM patterns, multi-agent systems, and frontier AI capabilities.
* Drive innovation through creation of POCs, labs, reusable accelerators, and platform assets.
* Define and scale enterprise AI platforms, reusable accelerators, and engineering ecosystems across engagements.
* Establish governance models for AI engineering, including evaluation frameworks, performance standards, and responsible AI practices.
* Guide teams on advanced AI implementation approaches, including fine-tuning strategies, optimization techniques, and system-level design.
* Lead and mentor architects, engineers, and cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality AI solutions.
* Provide strategic oversight for complex programs, ensuring alignment with architectural vision and business objectives.
* Contribute to go-to-market initiatives, practice-level AI propositions, and thought leadership assets.
* Represent EY in client forums, innovation discussions, and external thought leadership engagements.

**Cyber Experience (Any One Preferred):**
**Application Security:**

* Enterprise-scale secure AI architecture strategy and DevSecOps integration for AI systems
* Convergence of AI with secure SDLC, CI/CD pipelines, API security, identity, and cloud-native security controls

**Offensive Security:**

* AI-driven threat modeling, adversarial evaluation strategies, and red teaming frameworks
* Convergence of AI with VAPT methodologies, attack simulations, and emerging AI threat landscapes

**Technical Skills and Expertise:**

* Strong proficiency in Python with ability to prototype complex AI solutions when required
* Deep expertise in AI/LLM tools such as OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, Gemini, or similar
* Advanced knowledge of AI frameworks: LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or equivalents
* Strong understanding of AI architecture patterns: RAG, agentic systems, multi-agent orchestration, and scalable pipelines
* Cloud platforms: Azure (preferred), AWS, or GCP with architecture-level expertise
* AI platforms: Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Hugging Face, Vertex AI, or similar
* Vector databases and retrieval systems: Pinecone, FAISS, Azure AI Search, Weaviate, or equivalents
* Observability, monitoring, and evaluation frameworks for AI systems
* DevOps, CI/CD, and platform engineering practices

**Soft Skills and Attributes**
:
  
  

* Strong technology leadership and architectural vision
* Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to translate complex AI concepts into business-aligned solutions
* Innovation mindset with passion for emerging technologies
* Ability to influence and drive change across teams and organizations

**Performance Expectations / KPIs:**

* Impact on enterprise architecture quality and scalability
* Adoption of AI platforms, accelerators, and reusable assets
* Innovation output including POCs, labs, and thought leadership assets
* Contribution to practice growth and capability maturity
* Effectiveness in mentoring architects and engineering leaders

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, AI/ML, Cybersecurity, or related field
* 12+ years of experience in AI engineering, architecture, or advanced technology consulting
* Proven experience leading complex AI transformation and architecture initiatives
* Strong track record of driving innovation and technology adoption
* Relevant certifications (preferred):

+ Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect / AI Engineer
+ AWS Solutions Architect / Machine Learning Specialty
+ Certified Information Systems Security Professional

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

title: Professional Services Engineer
description:
**ABOUT XPLORETEQ**

Xploreteq is a Pune-based technology and cybersecurity company working with organisations across cybersecurity, AI governance, data protection and DPDP readiness — through advisory, implementation and managed services. We are ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified, serve 50+ enterprise customers across financial services, healthcare, technology, manufacturing and services, and partner with leading platforms including Netskope, CrowdStrike, Menlo Security, Proofpoint, Okta, Varonis and Forcepoint. As we scale our team across sales, delivery and operations, we're looking for people who want to build a specialist practice rather than join a generalist IT shop.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

We are seeking a client-facing Professional Services Engineer to lead the technical implementation, architecture and integration of edge security solutions for our enterprise clients. Working from a System Integrator perspective, you will assess client environments, design the deployment architecture, and execute migrations onto modern Zero-Trust platforms — bridging legacy infrastructure (on-prem proxies, MPLS) and cloud-native SASE/SSE.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Assessment & Design**

•   Lead technical discovery workshops to map legacy architecture, application portfolios and traffic flows.

•   Author High-Level and Low-Level Design documentation covering traffic steering, proxy chaining, SSL decryption policy and fallback mechanisms.

•   Help clients plan prerequisites — allowlists, firewall exceptions, certificate authority provisioning, IdP sync.

**SASE/SSE Implementation**

•   Build, configure and validate tenants covering Secure Web Gateway, CASB and ZTNA.

•   Implement DLP policies aligned to client regulatory requirements (PCI-DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, DPDP) with custom detection rules.

•   Configure traffic steering and client deployment via MDM/GPO, including bypass and smart-steering rules.

•   Deploy Remote Browser Isolation and content-sanitisation (CDR) controls where in scope.

**Integration & Go-Live**

•   Integrate platforms with client Identity Providers (Azure AD/Entra ID, Okta) for provisioning and group-based policy.

•   Configure log/event forwarding into the client's SIEM (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, etc.).

•   Design and execute UAT test matrices; provide post-go-live hypercare support; run technical training and handover sessions for the client's internal operations team.

**REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS**

•   3–6 years as a Cyber Security Engineer, Consultant or Professional Services engineer, ideally within a System Integrator or MSP.

•   Hands-on deployment experience with at least one SASE/SSE platform (Netskope preferred) or isolation platform (Menlo Security); familiarity with a second (Zscaler, Palo Alto Prisma Access, Forcepoint) is a strong plus.

•   Working knowledge of proxy configuration (PAC files, explicit vs. transparent), GRE/IPsec tunnelling, TLS/SSL inspection and routing fundamentals.

•   Experience deploying endpoint agents at scale via Intune, SCCM, JAMF or GPO.

**PREFERRED CERTIFICATIONS**

•   Netskope Cloud Security Integrator (NCSI) or Cloud Security Administrator (NCSA).

•   Palo Alto PCNSE, CISSP or CCSP are a plus.

**COMPETENCIES & SOFT SKILLS**

•   Comfortable walking into varied, unpredictable client environments and deploying a modern security stack on top of messy legacy networks.

•   Strong documentation discipline for HLD/LLDs and runbooks.

•   Able to run more than one client engagement at different lifecycle stages at once.

**WHAT WE VALUE**

At Xploreteq, we value people who take responsibility, communicate openly, solve problems practically, and contribute beyond the boundaries of a job description. For this role, we're particularly looking for someone who can be dropped into a messy client environment and bring order to it.

**REPORTING**

Reports to the Tech Lead.

**TO APPLY**

Interested candidates can share their updated CV to HR@xploreteq.com along with:

•   Current CTC

•   Expected CTC

•   Notice period

•   Current location

•   Brief summary of relevant experience for this role

title: AVP,  Data Architect (L11)
description:
**Role Title: AVP, Data Architect (L11\)**
**Company Overview:** 
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 Synchrony's Engineering Team is a dynamic and innovative team dedicated to driving technological excellence. As a member of this Team, you'll play a pivotal role in designing and developing cutting\-edge tech stack and solutions that redefine industry standards.
   

  

 The Credit Card that we use every day to purchase our essentials and later settle the bills \- A simple process that we all are used to on a day to day basis. Now, consider the vast complexity hidden behind this seemingly simple process, operating tirelessly for millions of cardholders. The sheer volume of data processed is mind\-boggling. Fortunately, advanced technology stands ready to automate and manage this constant torrent of information, ensuring smooth transactions around the clock, 365 days a year.
   

  

 Our collaborative environment encourages creative problem\-solving and fosters career growth. Join us to work on diverse projects, from fintech to data analytics, and contribute to shaping the future of technology. If you're passionate about engineering and innovation.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 The AVP, Data Architect owns how data is sourced, modeled, governed, and delivered for analytic workloads, reporting/dashboarding and agentic AI solutions. The Data Architect will need to develop intimate knowledge of SYF key data domains (originations, loan activity, collection, etc.) and maintain a holistic view across SYF functions to design performant, resilient and cost\-effective data solutions.
   

  

 This role requires strong hands\-on experience for preparing data for AI data pipelines so agents can reliably access high\-quality, compliant information. The role partners closely with the data engineering team, AI Platform team, the data governance team, data science/analytics teams, and business stakeholder teams to define data architecture, standards, and operating models that enable scalable, secure, and cost\-effective analytics and AI workloads. This leader combines deep data architecture skills, strong understanding of different data model methodology, ETL pipelines, AI/LLM/RAG patterns.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Define logical, physical data model structure, integrate, govern, and store data in the enterprise repositories for supporting analytics/data science workloads, reporting/dashboarding and agentic AI workloads.
* Execute POCs and prototypes in sandbox and lab environments to propose solutions for AWS cloud workloads and AI solutions using data on AWS.
* Document data flow diagrams. Ensure discipline in the creation of Logical Data Models and their later implementation as Physical Data Structures.
* Define the target\-state Data \& AI Foundations architecture supporting agentic AI use cases, enterprise knowledge graph or metadata layer, data products, and AI\-ready datasets.
* Assist in developing the strategy and roadmap for making key enterprise data sources "AI\-ready": curation, quality, metadata, access patterns, latency requirements, and retention.
* Partner with source system owners (core servicing, CRM, collections, risk, fraud, etc.) to define data contracts, SLAs, and integration patterns that support downstream analytics.
* Establish data preparation and curation pipelines for model fine\-tuning, including dataset selection, labeling strategies, quality validation, versioning, and compliance with model risk policies.
* Define and enforce data governance policies for AI: data classification, lineage, access controls, PII handling, retention, and usage logging for AI workloads.
* Partner with AI Governance/Model Risk and InfoSec/AppSec to ensure data usage in prompts, context, and tools adheres to policies, including regulatory, privacy, and model risk requirements.
* Establish data quality and observability practices for AI data: data SLAs, freshness, completeness, drift detection, and business rule validation tied to AI outcomes.
* Drive adoption of metadata and catalog tools so platform and agent teams can discover, understand, and safely consume datasets.
* Define and oversee patterns for integrating external data (third\-party, public, partner data) into AI workflows, including licensing checks, quality assessment, and monitoring.
* Perform other duties and/or special projects as assigned.


**Qualifications/Requirements**
* Minimum 6\+ years of experience across data engineering, data architecture, or analytics platforms, with at least 3\+ years in cloud data platforms and enterprise data leadership roles.
* Strong experience with modern cloud data stacks (e.g., data warehouses like Redshift/Snowflake/BigQuery, relational databases like PostgreSQL, and object storage) and their use in analytics and AI.
* Demonstrated expertise in enabling data readiness for agentic AI from existing data stores in front\-end (OLTP) applications or analytical (OLAP) applications like data lake and warehouses. Strong hands\-on experience on designing data models (star schema, 3NF) for raw, standardized and curated data products for optimal performance and scalability of data applications for AI.
* Strong hands\-on experience in generating semantic layers for the data products that serve multiple consuming applications on AWS.
* Proven experience building data pipelines for AI/ML use cases including ETL/ELT workflows, streaming data integration, and data preparation for model training and fine\-tuning.
* Strong experience with Lakehouse architecture using S3, Apache Iceberg, Glue Data Catalog, Redshift
* Strong Python skills for building data processing, evaluation, and automation pipelines, plus familiarity with DevOps practices (CI/CD, infrastructure as code, environment management).
* Good understanding of identity and data security architecture \- IAM, IAM Identity Center, cross account data access patterns, identity propagation for AI agents and services
* Good understanding of AWS infrastructure concepts (networking, security, storage, compute) and how they apply to data and AI workloads.
* Experience working with ETL/ELT pipelines, streaming data, and integration technologies (e.g., CDC, APIs, event buses) for both batch and real\-time use cases.
* Proven ability to lead multi\-disciplinary teams and influence across platform, AI, data, and business stakeholders.


**Desired Skills/ Knowledge**
* Experience implementing or leveraging knowledge graphs, entity resolution, or semantic search to power AI and RAG use cases.
* Solid understanding of LLM and agentic AI patterns (prompts, tools, RAG, memory) and how data quality and structure impact AI behavior and performance.
* Background in building data products specifically targeted for AI/ML (feature stores, labeled datasets, evaluation datasets, fine\-tuning corpora).
* Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF) as they apply to data and AI.
* Prior experience in financial services, credit, payments, or similar domains where data lineage, explainability, and audit trails are critical.
* Basic AWS solution architecture knowledge including core services, AWS S3, Redshift, Amazon Bedrock, and Bedrock AgentCore so they can collaborate effectively with platform and agent teams.
* Good understanding of enterprise data governance and access controls like AWS Lake Formation, Glue Data catalog and metadata management frameworks.
* Team player, strong engagement, positive attitude and natural curiosity are highly desired.


**Eligibility Criteria**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 6\+ years of experience across data engineering, data architecture, or analytics platforms, with at least 3\+ years in cloud data platforms and enterprise data leadership roles.
* Strong familiarity with streaming through Kafka and other Data Lake technologies and techniques.
* Strong familiarity with data governance, data lineage, data processes, DML, and data architecture control execution
* Strong experience with business analysis \- Requirements analysis and conversion to data models.
* Must be able to develop creative solutions to problems.

**The Opportunity**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is seeking a Senior AI Engineer to support the design and delivery of AI\-led solutions across Identity and Access Management and Cybersecurity domains.  As a senior profile, the candidate will work closely with IAM, Cyber, cloud and business stakeholders to understand client problems, identify practical AI opportunities and convert them into working solutions, prototypes and scalable delivery assets. The focus is not only on technology implementation, but also on improving identity risk visibility, access decisioning, governance efficiency and operational effectiveness.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should bring strong hands\-on engineering experience, curiosity to work in the IAM and Cyber domain, and the ability to apply AI, automation and analytics to solve real enterprise identity challenges. While the role requires practical exposure to AI and IAM technologies, the emphasis is on problem solving, consulting mindset, solution ownership and the ability to contribute to enterprise\-scale IAM transformation programs.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop and operationalize AI solutions for IAM and Cybersecurity use cases across SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, IGA, PAM, AD/Entra ID and NHI domains.
* Build hands\-on AI/ML capabilities using Python, PowerShell, LLM/SLM APIs, embeddings, RAG, LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, ADKs and AI orchestration engines.
* Develop agentic AI workflows, copilots and automation frameworks for access requests, certification campaigns, provisioning, privileged access, remediation and identity operations.
* Integrate AI solutions with SailPoint, Saviynt, CyberArk, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Azure, AWS, Microsoft Graph API, SIEM/SOAR, Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike and XDR platforms.
* Analyze identity, access, privilege, vault, directory, activity and security logs to identify risk patterns, anomalies, access recommendations, role mining opportunities and policy gaps.
* Support AI\-driven IAM governance including risk\-based authentication, risk\-based provisioning, access reviews, compliance checks, SOD, identity lifecycle orchestration and audit\-ready reporting.
* Apply ML, classification, optimization, time series analysis, pattern recognition, NLP, UEBA, anomaly detection and predictive risk scoring for identity and access intelligence.
* Work on Non\-Human Identity use cases including service accounts, managed identities, service principals, enterprise applications, API\-based identities, workload identities, agent identities, token misuse and agent overreach controls.
* Contribute to PAM analytics and automation across CyberArk, Privilege Cloud, EPM, EPV, CPM, PSM, JIT/JEA, password rotation, secret lifecycle management, session monitoring and vault log analytics.
* Create dashboards and insights using Power BI, Tableau and identity analytics views to explain access risk, compliance posture, user activity trends and remediation priorities.
* Collaborate with business, cyber and IAM stakeholders to convert problem statements into working prototypes, scalable solutions and executive\-ready recommendations.


**QUALIFICATIONS:**
**Required Skills**
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in AI engineering, software development, data science, automation, cybersecurity analytics or IAM technology delivery.
* Practical experience building AI applications using LLM/SLM APIs, RAG, embeddings, prompt engineering, agentic AI, AI agents, copilots and multi\-agent workflows.
* Strong programming and automation experience in Python, PowerShell, APIs, SQL basics and Microsoft Graph API; exposure to HTML, CSS and JavaScript is preferred.
* Hands\-on exposure to Azure AI, OpenAI, AWS, Python\-based AI/ML frameworks, ML models, classification, optimization, NLP, pattern recognition, time series analysis and anomaly detection.
* Working knowledge of IAM concepts including SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, SAML, OAuth, OIDC with PKCE, authentication, authorization, federation, certificate management and key management.

* Experience or strong exposure to IGA platforms and concepts such as SailPoint, Saviynt, identity lifecycle, access reviews, certification campaigns, role mining, SOD, access risk and policy compliance.
* Experience or strong exposure to PAM concepts and tools including CyberArk, Privilege Cloud, EPM, EPV, CPM, PSM, JIT/JEA, password rotation, secrets, session monitoring and vault logs.

For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview** 
 : This role is within Source to Pay (S2P) organization in Synchrony. The Source\-to\-pay is the entire end\-end\-end process involved in procurement. It spans every process, from spend management, strategic sourcing, and third\-party risk management to contract management, purchasing, performance management and accounts payable. Our goal is to source high value products, software, and services that accelerate our growth, our new way of working, speed our innovations to market, and make us even more responsive to partners and customers.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**

Also, you will have the opportunity to work closely with stakeholders and our AI working group to configure Procurement, Sourcing, Risk \& Contracts modules of Synchrony’s Coupa system as per Synchrony’s Source to Pay organizations requirements. * Develop and maintain configuration timelines, documentation

* Graduate or Post\-Graduate in any discipline with 5\+ years of overall work experience in IT industry, or in lieu of a degree 7\+ years of overall work experience in IT industry
* Minimum 5\+ years of business knowledge in Procurement, Supplier Management, Contracts (CLMA), Sourcing, Accounts Payable

* Ability to take responsible and ethical decisions while implementing AI features
* Ability to handle sensitive issues with uncompromising integrity and confidentiality

* Graduate or Post\-Graduate in any discipline with 5\+ years of overall work experience in IT industry, or in lieu of a degree 7\+ years of overall work experience in IT industry.

 Job Description: Conversion SME (Manager)
   

  

**Position Title:** 
 Manager – Conversion Subject Matter Expert (Life Insurance \& Annuities Policy Administration Transformation)
   

  

**Function:** 
 Insurance
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bangalore / Chennai / Coimbatore / Kochi / Kolkata / Noida /Hyderabad / Pune / Trivandrum
   

  

 Role Summary
   

  

 The Conversion SME will own the end\-to\-end data and policy conversion strategy for a Life \& Annuities policy administration system transformation (e.g., legacy platform to FAST/Majesco/OIPA/FINEOS target). This role bridges business, actuarial, and technical teams to ensure accurate, compliant, and auditable migration of in\-force policy data, values, and transaction history from source to target systems.
   

  

 Key Roles \& Responsibilities
   

  

**Conversion Strategy \& Governance**
* Define the end\-to\-end conversion approach: crosswalk methodology, data mapping standards, tolerance thresholds, and reconciliation framework between legacy and target platforms.
* Own the conversion playbook — cutover strategy (big\-bang vs. phased/wave\-based), fallback/rollback plans, and freeze\-period governance.
* Establish data lineage documentation and version\-controlled mapping specs for audit and regulatory traceability.


**Business \& Technical Bridge**
* Translate legacy policy administration rules (billing, values, riders, beneficiaries, agent/commission structures) into target system configuration requirements.
* Partner with actuarial, IT, and QA teams to validate converted policy values (cash value, reserves, death benefit, surrender values) against source\-of\-truth calculations.
* Lead root\-cause analysis on conversion breaks/exceptions and drive remediation with configuration or ETL teams.


**Data Mapping \& Rules Definition**
* Author functional specifications for field\-level, transaction\-level, and history conversion (policy, billing, claims\-in\-progress, agent/commission, correspondence).
* Define exception handling rules for non\-standard policies, riders, or legacy product variants that don't map cleanly to the target chart of accounts/product model.
* Validate mapping specs with source system SMEs and target platform configuration leads.


**Testing \& Reconciliation**
* Design and oversee conversion test cycles (mock conversions, parallel runs, dress rehearsals) and define pass/fail acceptance criteria.
* Own policy\-level and aggregate\-level reconciliation reporting (financial tie\-outs, record counts, value tolerances) presented to governance/steering forums.
* Sign off on conversion readiness gates ahead of each cutover wave.


**Team \& Stakeholder Management**
* Lead and mentor a pod of conversion analysts/testers (onshore/offshore); manage workload, quality, and delivery timelines.
* Act as primary conversion point of contact for client business owners, actuarial, compliance, and IT conversion teams.
* Present conversion status, risk, and exception dashboards to steering committee/PMO.


**Compliance \& Risk**
* Ensure conversion approach aligns with regulatory requirements (state filings, policyholder notification rules, NAIC/IFRS 17 where applicable).
* Maintain audit trail documentation sufficient for internal audit and regulatory examination.


 Must\-Have Skills
   

  

**Category**
**Requirement**
**Domain**
 9
   

  

**Platform**
 Hands\-on conversion experience on at least one target PAS: FAST, Majesco, OIPA, FINEOS, or equivalent legacy modernization platform
   

  

**Conversion\-specific**
 Prior experience in at least one full PAS conversion/migration cycle — mapping, mock conversions, parallel testing, cutover
   

  

**Data**
 Strong SQL skills; experience with data mapping/ETL concepts; policy value reconciliation (cash value, reserves, COI, fund values for annuities)
   

  

**Documentation**
 Ability to write field\-level functional specs, mapping documents, and test scripts to consulting\-grade standards
   

  

**Delivery**
 Experience managing a pod, sprint/wave\-based delivery, and reporting into a governance/PMO structure
   

  

**Regulatory**
 Familiarity with state insurance regulations, policyholder notification requirements, and IFRS 17/statutory reporting impacts on conversion
   

  

**Preferred Skills**
* Prior Big 4/IT Service Company or systems integrator consulting background
* Experience with both Life and Annuities product lines (not just one)
* Exposure to agile delivery frameworks (Scrum/SAFe) in a conversion pod context
* Group Benefits conversion exposure (cross\-domain flexibility)
* Vendor\-side experience (e.g., having worked at a FAST/Majesco/FINEOS implementation partner)


**Credentials/Certifications (Preferred, Not Mandatory)**
* LOMA certifications relevant to conversion/operations
* CSPO® / PMP® / Prosci (change management) for delivery\-side credibility
* Platform\-specific certifications (FAST, Majesco, FINEOS) where available
